'''Wight footsoldiers''' are undead enemies summoned by [[Sliske]] encountered during [[Sliske's Endgame]]. Several also play a role in some of the puzzles in [[Sliske's Labyrinth]], where they are carrying masks needed to complete the puzzle in the room.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Sliske's Endgame - Frostworld Part 2|date=19 December 2016}}
** Added to game.
